notes.title: Free Demo updated! Feedback and Wishlists wanted!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Horror Tales fans![/h2]

You can download the [b]FREE Demo[/b] of Horror Tales The Beggar, sequel of [b]Horror Tales The Wine[/b] in the steam main page of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343340/HORROR_TALES_The_Beggar/]Horror Tales The Beggar[/url]. The Demo features sections of the first four levels of the game. Give it a try, it is free! Don't forget to WISHLIST!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343340/HORROR_TALES_The_Beggar/

[h2]Release June 17 2024 with a 40% discount.[/h2]

Three years have been put in the making of this game. It is a very beautiful moment for me. The final game will release[b] June 17 with a 40% discount.[/b] That means it is also a great time to[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343340/HORROR_TALES_The_Beggar/] wishlist[/url] Horror Tales The Beggar now!

[h2]A HUGE Demo Update[/h2]

The release of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343340/HORROR_TALES_The_Beggar/]Free Demo of Horror Tales The BEGGAR [/url]was a [b]HUGE success[/b]. One of the reasons I launched the Demo was to get feedback and OH BOY, the community did delivered! To everyone that shared feedback: a big thank you. Sometimes I am so focused in the details of the development that some things just slip by. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/0f0df36c8d5ddae103d074abab0e09b37de21513.gif[/img]

After a weekend to relax, it was time to get working again and today I give you the first update of the Demo! [b]In this update you will find new features and refined gameplay.[/b] All implemented thanks to your suggestions :) 

[h2]Important new features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] The overall brightness of the night battle against Morvin has been increased so players can read the combat more clearly.
[*] While changing the time of the day, now the current option appears, so there are always three options (Miday, Sunset and Night). Players got confused with only two options showed so I decided to also include the current option. If you change to that option, simply nothing happens.
[*] Grabbing objets is now way easier and doesn't require you to look exactly in the middle of them.
[*] Grabbed objects now appear lower in the screen so you actually see what is going on in front of you while grabbing and charging them.
[*] Some big objects in the boss fight arena like boxes and barrels have also been scaled 0.9 so they when you grab them they do not obscure your view
[*] The idle and walking animations have been refined so while in those states you don't see two floaty hands.
[*] There is a new ingame cinematic in the desert with the drone after losing him in the canyon. If will fly thowards your objective.
[*] The "change time" tutorial now indicates you need to move the mouse up and down to change between day states.
[*] The small fires now emit true light.
[*] The reespawn system has been improved. Now you won't be stuck in some rocks after falling and then reespawning.
[*] The intro cinematic text have been changed to indicate the drone spent 32 years looking for you more clearly.

[/list]

[h1]NEW LANGUAGES![/h1]

Thanks to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1343340/discussions/0/4355621052302998980/]community localizations[/url], we now have support to [b]Turkish AND Korean[/b]! Thanks a lot to the community members Gökhan KOCAMAN and 손승호 for the amazing work! [b]With Portuguese, Dutch and German, we now have 5 of the 11 languages localized by the community![/b] You are awesome. Of course, now you have ingame easter eggs and also appear in the credits. Only French, Arabic, Italian, Danish, Finnish, Greek and Swidish localizations remain to be done!  Do you want to help? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1343340/discussions/0/4355621052302998980/]Take a look here[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/c8f1ddebe19a18e033328a8d4faba5efe1bbeda1.gif[/img]

So, that's it for now. This week I'll try to implement [b]support for SFR and aditional DLSS config settings.[/b] Now it is your time to play the demo and give me feedback! What do you think about these new features?[b] Anything you think should be fixed?[/b]

A big hug,

Carlos.

notes.title: About the recent Negative Steam Reviews [Game Update]
notes.content:
Hello players,

In the last two weeks, the percentage of negative reviews this game recieved went a lot higher than usual. Those reviews usually complain about one of the following points:

- The game has too much lore text.

- The game has jumpscares.

- The game doesn't take 40 hours to complete.

- The game makes you solve puzzles while being chased.

So, step by step, let's analize those issues:

[h1]"The game has too much lore text"[/h1]

Currently,[b] the word count of all texts in the game is 5624 word[/b]. This amount is not a lot, specially compared to other, more narrative focused games. The texts are also spread across 5 levels and yes, there are a lot of texts you can read in the levels to give you more context of what happened in the world of the game! 

[b]However, most of those texts are optional and are not required to be found or read to understand the main story.[/b] If you read them you will understand more subtle things or you can even discover the big plottwist at the end before hand, but they are not mandatory to understand either the ending or the broad strokes of what happened during the Devil's Fever pandemic in the capital.

So yes, please don't worry if the game has too much lore text. If you don't want to read them it is totally ok! The texts that are important to understand the story are also presented in such a way that are obvious they are important. That is all I can say without entering in spoiler territory.

[h1]The game has jumpscares[/h1]

Yes,[b] the game has jumpscares[/b]. That's it. If you don't like jumpscares, there are plenty of other horror games to play! In defense of the jumpscares of The Wine, I'll say [b]I tried my best for them to not be Cheap jumpscares[/b]. I like to thing they are well crafted and integrated in the context. But yes, there are one or two really cheap jumpscares, but those are there because once they happen you won't expect any other more well crafted jumpscare or chase right after those cheap one happen... right? :)

[h1]The game doesn't take 40 hours to complete.[/h1]

Yes. This is a game done by a solo developer and you bought it for[b] 15$ or less if you bought it on a sale. Don't expect it to last 40 hours.[/b] In a normal playthough it will last you less than 10 hours. Yes, the game is short, but it is intense. [b]It doesn't have filler levels or sections. Everything is relevant. This game respects your time[/b] :_)

[h1]The game makes you solve puzzles while being chased.[/h1]

This is the big bad one! In 3 (just three, I promise) sections of this game you will be asked to solve a puzzle... while being chased by a maniac. The puzzle itself is not usually dificult, instead, what makes it difficult is the constant chasing. I understand this is not something usual in most horror games and while I love it and most players do, [b]I understand why it can be frustrating, specially the end challenge. [/b]That's why after a lot of thinking...[b] The game has just been updated with a new feature![/b]

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]

As soon as you hit "New Game", a new disclaimer screen will pop up:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/44f6b41ae91f778a65f2bc6c8e33d775db0a235a.jpg[/img]

If at any time during your playtheough of the game you pause it and go to the accessibility menu, you will find the new "[b]No Chasing and Puzzle Solving Mode[/b]". If you activate this mode, enemies in those area will disappear a minute after they appear and yes, the enemy music will stop too! You can activate this mode at any give time or during those sections. As soon as it is activated, enemies will disappear after exactly 60 seconds.

The areas where this mode takes effect are: The second sea of Wine, The end puzzle of the second level and the last challenge of the game beneath the cellar. The other chases are either very short ones or they don't require you to solve any puzzle.

So... yes! That's it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/8bffa20630ce3d4a9ed0e566aaa06d0a20263951.jpg[/img]

[h1]A final message from the solo dev of this game[/h1]

Just to finish this post I would like you to know[b] I take the feedback you give me very seriously. [/b]The good feedback and the bad feedback. Everything will improve the Horror Tales Saga. However, when this feedback takes for of a negative Steam review, you may be doing something you don't realise: hurting the game and my sanity. 

[b]Because of the way the Steam Algorithm works, negative reviews can really affect the discoveravility of this game on the algorithm.[/b] This is not Resident Evil or any big horror game. In those games with 10.000 reviews per month a single review is meaningless. But in this game... it counts. A lot. Maybe more than you imagine.[b] Currently the game only have a little bit more than 100 reviews and every negative review is a shot to the game.[/b]

I understand that if you have feedback or suggestions for the game, the review system may seem like a great place to do so, but please just bear in mind that [b]you can also post a new discusion and I'll gladly answer. [/b]As you can see I answer everything! You don't need to post a negative Steam Review so you get my attention :) All I want to say is if you didn't like the game, please make a negative review of it! No problem at all! But if you loved everything about it except one or two features, please think twice because[b] it can really hurt the future of the Horror Tales Saga[/b] T . T

On the other hand, if you have something positive to say, please leave a review too, of course! It doesn't matter that it is not writter in English! Actually if it is written in another language different than english it is going to be better for the discoveravility of the game in users using that language. annd... I think that's all for now.

Oh... just one little, liiiittle thing. Stay tunned for a [b]free Halloween update[/b] :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/23c67ebf1fed7b82c94a99b2b5e3f9ef2088013a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: French, Dutch and Turkish Community Translations Update and more!
notes.content:
Hi! I am Carlos, the solo gamedev behind this game!

A lot of you asked for new languages to be added into the game and I thought it would be awesome if we could get those languages done by the community itself. That's how community localizations began!

You can read or join to make extra languages here: 

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1340640/discussions/0/4939872515513977034/

This is how Turkish and French localizations were made by the awesome Arenx (French) and Gökhan Kocman (Turkish). 

Besides this, other changes of the game have been made. Here are those.

- Added Community translations for French, Dutch and Turkish.

- Added an speedrun accessible only easter egg in honor of Trevalian, the first speedrunner to get a sub 10:00 time! :D

- Fixed minor bugs and issues.

Thanks to IrukaIcarus, Arenz and Gökhan Kocman for the community localizations. Yor are heroes!

okey thats all... but but waaait! WHAT ABOUT THE FREE DEMO?!?!?! Yes, yes, I know I promised a free demo once we got to 100 reviews. It is still coming and it will be released this september. I still have some stuff to figure out before doing so.

With that being said, if you want to help with the community translations, we are still looking for a translation for DEUTCH, PORTUGUESE and KOREAN!

You can check how to make those here!

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1340640/discussions/0/4939872515513977034/

A big hug to everyone,

keep the spooks comming!

notes.title: Accessibility Options in the HORROR TALES Saga
notes.content:
Hello Players! Let me get to the juicy stuff right away because I have SO MUCH to explain. 

First of all, who the fuck I am to tell my players how to play my games? This essentially means that to get the same level of immersion, different players need diferent options activated or deactivated. So, in order to make the life of everyone easier, all games in the HORROR TALES Saga (including of course The Wine) have implemented a series of accessibility options so anyone can play. But actually, it goes beyond that. You can also use the accessibility menu to make the game LESS accessible! We will talk about that later. 

Aditionally, [b]PC players get a full video configuration menu[/b]. But I'll explain that in a separate post.

These are the main options of the accessibility menu. You can access this menu either from the Main Menu or the in-game pause menu:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/8b6d7ce614d0faea8c36d1241b5d7598f7eb7b30.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/af5aa4878b914eca22dfdd7811d338c7cca252a8.jpg[/img]

All options are more or less self explanatory but there are a couple of them I'd like to take a deep dive: 

[b]Immersive Mode: [/b]Enabling this mode will totally disable all HUD texts. But don't worry, the ingame text on the props is also localized! For maximum immersion, you can also disable the glowing outlines of the objects and the crosshair! Not a single element on screen that isn't part of the gameworld!

[b]Unlock Photomode:[/b] When you complete the game, you will gain access to the photomode. I'll talk more about the photomode in a separate post, but you can actually use it for more than taking awesome artsy takes! You can use the photomode to unlock some areas an unveil some secrets there. But if you want to use the photomode straight away, just unlocked in the accessibility Menu and that's it! :D

[h1]Full gamepad and keyboardRemapping Options.[/h1]

The game also has full remapping of buttons in two separate menus: Gamepad Menu and Keyboard Menu. But again, it goes beyond that. Not only you can change the inputs. You can actually change how some actions work like holding down the button to crouch or run or press down to crouch and press again to uncrouch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/3a939848dbadc9764a3a14d74410f8c8a1caad63.jpg[/img]

These are just the obvious accessibility features, but the game implements accessibility features outside of the accessibility menu! For example, all the levels of the game are unlocked by default. This means if you buy the game and you just want to take pictures in the third level, you can do it right away! More features are implemented (like separate audio tracks configurators and diferent languages) but honestly, there is a thin thiiin line between accessibility and good game design and I am afraid that is something you will have to judge by yourself once you play the game :)

This features are available across all platforms: Steam, Epic Games Store, Nintendo Switch, PS5, PS4, One, Series X|S

To end this post, you will find here how the game can look tweaking a bit the accessibility options. The first one is the default look, the second and the third one the look after some tweaking!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/e676b9e5846b5921e592a5d6aac467b773501788.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/ff7cdfc7d64dd657a236926fa3575227e9bb5a92.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/9833416c850fb0df9259658855af42aa46d68fed.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Steam Autumn Festival DEMO updated!
notes.content:
Hello players! 

After hearing your feedback from the first day of the festival I've decided to update the game after some bug-fixing and gameplay balancing.  Here is what changed:

Changed the run mechanic a bit. Now it takes more time for the player to get tired.

Added an end of the Demo screen at the end.

Added more structures in the first snowy area to make clear you can go and explore there!

Changed the first password puzzle to make it impossible to solve without visiting the snowy area first.

When levers are broken, you take a little bit of damage now.

Major lighting improvements in all levels.

Fixed a back-tracking bug that didn't let you advance in the game in the first level.

Added more wood to the starting area to make the water tunnel route more obvious.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/ab61f8729ce8e08f3709802c3d7948df53d430a0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Accessibility options, Gamepad support, key bindings and MORE!
notes.content:
[h1]+12 Accessibility features[/h1]

In the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1340640/discussions/0/2650881941779061237/]Horror Tales Saga[/url], all games have a series of accessibility features by default to make each player's experience unique and suited for their own needs.

But not only that! You can also use the accessibility features to completly disable them and make the experience super immersive, with no hud, no texts on the screen or no glowing interactuable objects! 

Here you can find two screenshots of the accessibility menu inside the Horror Tales games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/b6a38c2175eb5fed0c331d1b0166d636bade7dd7.jpg[/img] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/c95b6ac47a3e2ae1b7cc3b1890b58640b2e2a81e.jpg[/img]

And a real example in-game of the diferent output tweaking the settings a bit! The first image is the default settings, and the second image the same scene with some tweaking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/9898ddefee785771b80a066689f708e9ec003d40.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/33d039dcee518526517aa83e82061ead13045703.jpg[/img]

[h1]Audio, Gamepad and key bindings[/h1]

But the accessibility features don't end in the accessibility menu! Aside from full gamepad support, you can customize your experience by binding keyboard/mouse keys and even gamepad keys to whatever suits you. But not only that, you can also customize the way certain actions work. For example, do you want to hold "Ctrl" to crouch or you prefer to Click "Ctrl" to crouch and click it again to uncrouch?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/a2bdf56fb4e9652d8373aa5470e05a7cbdcdfe0a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/49ce829f8540052e9adb732fa03ffdbe36f5f4bc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/6d79395f6e7529134e5856e055d602a7ec6d929f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37974263/b9f61d9f8b9a57a902fee673d54dc0ebbc7c4751.jpg[/img]

This is only a little glimpse at the Base Accessibility Features, there is more info to come!

Would you like to know more about the video settings options?

Follow us in the next announcement to know more about it!

Regards,

Carlos.
